description: T4 literature gate on the eight original v3-v8 Materials Project finalists plus mp-1195160 (Al2Bi2Cu2S3Cl8, promoted after T6). Every literature value comes from an opened primary or review source; values not verified in an opened source are stored as null and listed in unresolved_fields.

finalists.synthesised_phase_description: No. mp-861911 is a theoretical monoclinic C2/m polymorph (10 atoms/cell, dE_hull = 7.07 meV/atom, no ICSD entries). The experimentally synthesised mineral kermesite (Sb2OS2 / Sb2S2O) crystallizes in triclinic P-1 (20 atoms/cell, mp-28711, ICSD-12120/68346/189831-189835, dE_hull = 1.07 meV/atom) with a bulk fundamental optical band gap of 2.04 eV (nanoribbon indirect 1.59 eV, direct 2.13 eV).
unresolved_fields: measured_optical_gap_ev (mp-861911 C2/m polymorph is un-synthesised; triclinic kermesite mp-28711 has bulk gap 2.04 eV)
reported_pv_device (no solar cell device found in opened sources for monoclinic C2/m Sb2OS2)

citations.note: Reports bulk kermesite Sb2S2O (triclinic P-1) band gap of 2.04 eV and nanoribbon indirect/direct gaps of 1.59/2.13 eV.
Mineralogical crystallography of kermesite (Sb2S2O): triclinic P-1.

finalists.synthesised_phase_description: No. mp-1227486 is a theoretical cation-ordered Pnma 1:1 supercell (20 atoms/cell, no ICSD ID). Experimentally, (Bi_x Sb_{1-x})2S3 is synthesised as a disordered orthorhombic Pnma solid solution spanning stibnite Sb2S3 (mp-2809, 1.70 eV) and bismuthinite Bi2S3 (mp-22856, 1.32 eV), rather than a stoichiometric site-ordered BiSbS3 line compound.
unresolved_fields: measured_optical_gap_ev (ordered mp-1227486 BiSbS3 has no isolated experimental gap measurement in opened sources; end-members are 1.32 eV Bi2S3 and 1.70 eV Sb2S3)
reported_pv_device (no ordered BiSbS3 PV device record in opened sources)

citations.note: Pnma Sb2S3 experimental band gap 1.70 eV.
Pnma Bi2S3 experimental band gap 1.32 eV.

finalists.synthesised_phase_description: Unclear/theoretical in Materials Project (theoretical=True, dE_hull = 15.08 meV/atom, monoclinic P2_1/m, 10 atoms/cell), although linked to ICSD-290195. No primary experimental synthesis or optical measurement of P2_1/m BiInS3 could be verified in an opened source.
unresolved_fields: corresponds_to_synthesised_phase (linked to ICSD-290195 in MP metadata but flagged theoretical=True; primary crystal structure paper not open-access)

finalists.synthesised_phase_description: No. mp-1223998 (In(BiSe2)3 / Bi3InSe6, trigonal R3m, 10 atoms/cell, dE_hull = 17.99 meV/atom) is a theoretical Materials Project substitution structure with no ICSD entry and no experimental report.

No for the ordered defect-chalcopyrite cell mp-1224922 (tetragonal I-4, 7 atoms/cell, theoretical=True, no ICSD entry). While disordered tetragonal CuGaSnSe4 solid solutions exist in literature, no open-access primary optical gap or device record was verified in an opened source.
unresolved_fields: measured_optical_gap_ev (not verified in an opened primary source)
reported_pv_device (not verified in an opened primary source)

finalists.synthesised_phase_description: Yes. Orthorhombic Pnma emplectite (CuBiS2, 16 atoms/cell, ICSD-85134/34936/38779/171052, dE_hull = 0.0 meV/atom). However, its measured optical band gap is 1.50-1.65 eV (1.65 eV thin film in Temple et al., Phys. Chem. Chem. Phys. 2012), nearly double the old heuristic estimate of 0.85 eV, making it completely unsuitable as a 0.70-0.85 eV bottom IR scavenger.
unresolved_fields: reported_pv_device (Temple et al. 2012 evaluates CuBiS2 as a prospective thin-film absorber; no certified PV cell efficiency verified in opened sources)

citations.note: Temple, Kehoe, Scanlon & Watson (Phys. Chem. Chem. Phys. 2012, 14, 7099): Pnma emplectite CuBiS2 experimental optical absorption onset 1.65 eV (literature range 1.50-1.65 eV); HSE06 fundamental indirect gap 1.58 eV, direct gap 1.69 eV.

finalists.synthesised_phase_description: Yes. Monoclinic C2/m pavonite (AgBi3S5, 18 atoms/cell, ICSD-200110/171229, dE_hull = 0.0 meV/atom), confirmed as a stable equilibrium ternary line compound on the Ag2S-Bi2S3 pseudo-binary phase diagram.
unresolved_fields: measured_optical_gap_ev (not reported in opened open-access full texts)
reported_pv_device (no AgBi3S5 PV device reported in opened full texts)

citations.note: Confirms AgBi3S5 as a known equilibrium ternary phase along the Ag2S-Bi2S3 tie-line alongside AgBiS2.

finalists.synthesised_phase_description: No for the ordered defect-chalcopyrite cell mp-1224129 (tetragonal I-4, 7 atoms/cell, theoretical=True, no ICSD entry). No open-access primary optical gap or device record was verified in an opened source.
unresolved_fields: measured_optical_gap_ev (not verified in an opened primary source)
reported_pv_device (not verified in an opened primary source)

finalists.synthesised_phase_description: Yes. Hexagonal P6_3/m CuBiSCl2(AlCl3) / Al2Cu2Bi2S3Cl8 (34 atoms/cell, ICSD-428727, dE_hull = 6.03 meV/atom). Listed in Table 1 of Adv. Sci. 2025 (PMC12097054) as an experimentally synthesised quaternary chalcohalide with theoretical PBE band gap 1.27 eV and experimental band gap explicitly marked unmeasured ('-').
unresolved_fields: measured_optical_gap_ev (Table 1 of DOI 10.1002/advs.202413131 explicitly lists Bandgap (Exp.) as '-' / not measured)
reported_pv_device (Table 1 of DOI 10.1002/advs.202413131 lists no photovoltaic device)

citations.note: Adv. Sci. 2025 review of metal chalcohalides, Table 1: CuBiSCl2(AlCl3), P6_3/m, Bandgap (Exp.): -, Bandgap (Theory): 1.27 eV.
